waarom: Thumbnails v3, stijl gelijk aan Babylon (maanlogo, groot wit onderwerp, geel jaartal). VAST sinds 14 nov 2026 voor elke video (eigenaar): 'zodat je meteen een goed beeld hebt van waar de video over gaat, dus echt met de tijd, persoon en alles wat er toen gebeurde'. Dus 'kenmerk' groot rechts + 'moment': mensen van toen die doen wat er gebeurde. Nooit een losse willekeurige vrouw. tools/thumbnail_v3.py --alle maakt ze als de videokaart vrij is; de keten gebruikt <map>/thumbnail-v3.jpg.

videos.achtergrond: the torch-lit painted burial chamber of the Valley of the Kings with hieroglyphs
videos.kenmerk: the golden funeral mask of Tutankhamun with blue and gold stripes on top of his golden coffin
videos.moment: ancient Egyptian priests with shaved heads in white linen and a leopard skin, carrying offerings, oil lamps and a wooden shrine into the tomb, while mourning women in white dresses stand beside it

videos.achtergrond: a dry, dusty farm with a windmill and a wooden farmhouse under a low evening sun
videos.kenmerk: a dusty old farm truck piled high with furniture and suitcases on a dirt road in 1933, a wooden farmhouse and windmill
videos.moment: a thin Dust Bowl farm family of 1933, the father in worn overalls and a battered hat tying down a mattress, the mother in a faded cotton dress holding a child, loading chairs, a washtub and a mattress onto the truck

videos.achtergrond: green rolling fields, stone walls and a white church cupola at dusk
videos.kenmerk: the small red brick town of Gettysburg in 1863 with its white church cupola, a Union soldier's blue kepi and a brass bugle resting on a wooden fence in front
videos.moment: Union soldiers in dark blue uniforms and kepis marching into town while townspeople of 1863 in long dresses and waistcoats watch from their doorsteps

videos.kenmerk: a shiny dark blue 1961 Lincoln Continental open-top car parked on Elm Street in Dallas, 1963
videos.moment: crowds of 1963 Americans in suits, hats and pastel coats waving small flags along the sidewalk on a sunny autumn day

videos.achtergrond: the Plymouth shore with the Mayflower anchored in the bay at dusk
videos.kenmerk: a long rough wooden harvest table outdoors in 1621 laden with roasted wild turkey, corn, squash and bread, beside a small wooden Pilgrim house
videos.moment: Pilgrim families of 1621 in plain brown and black wool with white collars and coifs, and Wampanoag men with feathers and deerskin, sharing food together at the table
